space.expression: Collision tables scale with the number of guessed/stored partial secrets; source theorem does not give a common cn memory coefficient.

notes: The online expression is conditional on termination and on the source’s collision and per-loop heuristics. Basis reduction is a separate preprocessing cost. p is the admissibility/collision probability from Theorem 1, depending on the reduced-basis profile.

extra.parameters: Fix n,m,q; r=4c guessed coordinates; reduced q-ary basis B with root-Hermite factor δ.
extra.noise: Independent uniform binary error in {0,1}; recentered to ±1/2 before decoding.
extra.samples: Exactly the given m samples; comparisons instantiate at most m=2n.
extra.objective: Find a valid binary error and recover the secret.
extra.model: Nearest-plane plus meet-in-the-middle; p from Theorem 1; 2^16 operations per inner loop is an empirical estimate.
extra.assumptions: Heuristics 2 and 4; sufficient nearest-plane decoding quality for the correct residual target.
extra.success: Termination probability at least p₀=2^{−r}binom(r,2c) under Theorem 1 assumptions; amplification/restarts are additional.

evidence.locator: §3.2, Theorem 1, PDF pp. 8–9; §3.3 on preprocessing; §4 sample cap
evidence.sourceVersion: Author-hosted AFRICACRYPT 2016 manuscript; ePrint revision 13 April 2016
